visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an exterior street-level view of a multi-story urban building in daylight. A white circular sign with black text '丹利手作料理' is mounted above a black rectangular sign with identical lettering. Scooters are parked along the sidewalk in front of the storefront. (2) Inside, a male character in a pink polo shirt, surgical mask, and white cotton gloves presents a large golden platter holding a whole roasted chicken in a vertical orientation. The background features bright red chairs and a shelf with decorative items and tea canisters. (3) A sequence of culinary preparation follows, showing a large metal wok tossing mixed seafood, shrimp, and corn in a dark sauce. This is followed by a wide shot of a full table setting with multiple silver and gold-colored serving dishes. (4) Close-up detail of the roasted chicken shows hands in clear plastic gloves tearing the succulent meat away from the carcass. A hand dips a piece of the golden-yellow skin into a small porcelain dish containing an orange-brown spice powder. (5) Thick ribs coated in a dark, sesame-studded glaze are displayed. A metallic paw-shaped tong picks up one rib to show its texture. A subsequent shot shows a potato wedge being dipped into a red translucent sauce in a small dish. (6) A large seafood platter containing scallops, mussels, and shrimp is featured. Tongs are used to lift a large shrimp from the pile. The lighting is warm and bright, highlighting the steam and freshness of the ingredients. (7) Slices of beef are ladled from a golden bowl filled with a pale yellow broth, garnished with scallions and red chilies. A whole steamed fish, seasoned with green herbs and small red peppers, is presented on a decorative plate. (8) A rapid montage shows diverse side dishes: stir-fried sprouts with duck breast, braised cabbage in a rich yellow sauce, and a scoop of glutinous rice topped with shredded scallops and dried shrimp. A soup pot containing chicken and clams is briefly shown. (9) A white decorative crane centerpiece supporting small glasses sits on a dining table. A female staff member in a pink shirt and mask is seen arranging the table in a cozy, narrow dining room with a long table and red chairs. (10) The video concludes with an exterior shot of the restaurant's deep red entrance door. A black outdoor table and chairs are positioned on the sidewalk under an awning. Informational text overlays the scene.
